situation_kn: ಹಣದ ತೊಂದರೆ ಇದ್ದರೂ ರಮ್ಯಾ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡಿ, ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿವೇತನ ಪಡೆದು ತನ್ನ ವಿದ್ಯಾಭ್ಯಾಸವನ್ನು ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಳಿಸಿದಳು.
situation_en: Despite financial difficulties, Ramya worked part-time, earned a scholarship, and completed her education.
contextual_meaning: Draft for human verification: Determination helps people find solutions to difficulties.

situation_kn: ಕಡಿಮೆ ಆದಾಯವಿದ್ದರೂ ರವಿ ಸಾಲ ಮಾಡಿ ದುಬಾರಿ ಮೊಬೈಲ್ ಖರೀದಿಸಲು ಹೊರಟಿದ್ದಾನೆ. ಅವನಿಗೆ ಯಾವ ಸಲಹೆ ಕೊಡಬಹುದು?
situation_en: Ravi has a low income but plans to borrow money to buy an expensive phone. What advice would suit him?
contextual_meaning: Draft for human verification: Keep spending and ambitions within available resources.

situation_kn: ರೈತನು ಪ್ರತಿದಿನ ಹೊಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಷ್ಟಪಟ್ಟು ದುಡಿದು ಉತ್ತಮ ಬೆಳೆ ಬೆಳೆದು ತನ್ನ ಕುಟುಂಬಕ್ಕೆ ನೆಮ್ಮದಿಯ ಬದುಕು ಒದಗಿಸಿದನು.
situation_en: A farmer worked hard in his fields every day, grew a good harvest, and provided a comfortable life for his family.
contextual_meaning: Draft for human verification: Willingness to work brings sustenance and comfort.
